notes.priceTrigger: The maker's signed minOut is passed to the router as amountOutMinimum, so the price bound and the trigger are the same value. No oracle.
notes.venue: V3. The V2 factory has created no pair on any chain; the V3 pools are what /trade quotes. Paths are V3-packed: token || fee || token.
notes.output: Swapped straight to the maker; the contract never holds it.
notes.cancellation: cancel(order) per order, cancelAll() bumps the maker's epoch and kills every signature at once. Deleting a row from the off-chain store does not invalidate a signature.
